extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders preparing notice-and-comment submissions on FDA/CDC tobacco rulemaking (menthol/flavors), public health researchers, manufacturers, and advocacy groups
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare public comments and engagement materials in response to FDA/CDC proposed rules and information collections related to menthol-flavored tobacco, nicotine-yield standards, characterizing flavors in cigars, manufacturing practices, and MRTP renewals. Applies to parties wanting to influence or respond to regulatory science, procedural dockets, and data-collection notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: MRTP authorization renewal criteria (section 911(g))
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant seeks renewal of authorization to market products previously authorized under section 911(g)(2) of the FD&C Act as modified risk tobacco products with reduced exposure claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Renewal considerations focus on whether the product remains appropriate to be marketed as a modified risk tobacco product under the statutory framework; relates to premarket review and continuity of existing MRTP orders.

rubrics_metrics.name: MRTP public-health evaluation factors (section 911(g)(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: For the proposed MRTP, as it is actually used by consumers, the product must: (1) significantly reduce harm and the risk of tobacco-related disease to individual tobacco users; and (2) benefit the health of the population as a whole, taking into account both users of tobacco products and persons who do not currently use tobacco products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FDA must take into account the factors in section 911(g)(4) when evaluating whether a tobacco product benefits individual and population health; these two bullets are primary statutory benchmarks cited in MRTP evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishment of public docket and request for comments (TPSAC)
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA establishes a public docket for comments related to Tobacco Products Scientific Advisory Committee meetings and solicits public input.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meeting is open to the public and comments submitted to the docket are part of the record used to inform TPSAC deliberations and FDA decisionmaking; procedural requirement for notice-and-comment participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Menthol policy evaluation outcome metrics (CDC proposed data collection)
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed information collection aims to collect data on menthol-flavored tobacco product use, any tobacco use, quit rates, and product switching behaviors among adults 18 years of age and older.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outcomes of interest include commercial tobacco product use and related behavior, perceived access to menthol tobacco products, and menthol product–related beliefs and perceptions; study focuses on the general population and groups with higher menthol use prevalence (e.g., certain demographic groups).

rubrics_metrics.name: Tobacco product standard for nicotine yield (maximum nicotine level)
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA proposes a tobacco product standard that would establish a maximum nicotine level in cigarettes and certain other combusted tobacco products to reduce addictiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rationale and expected impacts described: reduce addictiveness, prevent experimenters from becoming regularly addicted, and facilitate quitting among addicted users; regulatory scope covers specified combusted products and anticipates population-level benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tobacco product standard for menthol in cigarettes (prohibit menthol as characterizing flavor)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed rule would prohibit menthol as a characterizing flavor in cigarettes and seeks data on menthol's role in initiation, cessation, switching, and dual use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FDA requested data on: (1) smoking initiation attributable to menthol, (2) the likelihood of smoking cessation among youth/young adults/adults, (3) the likelihood that menthol smokers would switch to another tobacco product or start dual use instead of quitting if menthol were prohibited, and (4) patterns of use of tobacco products—information to inform benefits/risks analysis for rulemaking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Tobacco Product Manufacturing Practice (TPMP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed rule to establish manufacturing practice requirements for manufacturers of finished and bulk tobacco products covering manufacture, preproduction design validation, packing, and storage to assure public health and compliance with chapter IX of the FD&C Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to apply broadly to manufacturers of finished and bulk tobacco products (with some exceptions for accessories); sets procedural and product-quality expectations to ensure public-health protections and statutory compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tobacco product standard for characterizing flavors in cigars
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed standard would prohibit characterizing flavors (other than tobacco) in all cigars and their components because flavors increase appeal and make cigars easier to use, particularly among youth and young adults.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Goal is to reduce appeal, experimentation, development of nicotine dependence, and progression to regular use; anticipated to reduce tobacco-related death, disease, and health disparities—used as a public-health justification for the product standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content and format requirements for Substantial Equivalence (SE) reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Final rule provides additional information on the content and format of SE Reports and establishes general procedures FDA will follow when evaluating SE Reports, including communications with applicants and confidentiality of data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rule aims to give applicants certainty and clarity about preparing and submitting SE Reports and describes FDA's evaluation procedures; includes procedural expectations for report structure, data presentation, and agency-applicant interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contraband cigarettes and smokeless tobacco trafficking thresholds and reporting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementation of PATRIOT Improvement Act provisions includes reducing the threshold amount of cigarettes triggering CCTA jurisdiction from a quantity in excess of 60,000 to a quantity in excess of 10,000; extending CCTA provisions to contraband smokeless tobacco; and expanding record-keeping and reporting requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Changes are procedural/regulatory standards for enforcement jurisdiction and compliance; rationale includes public-health and tax-avoidance concerns because trafficked tobacco reduces prices and promotes distribution of cheap tobacco.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listening sessions and public meetings for proposed tobacco product standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Virtual listening sessions and public meetings are convened to provide information on proposed regulations (menthol in cigarettes; characterizing flavors in cigars) and to provide the public an opportunity to comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These sessions function as outreach and record-building activities to solicit perspectives and data from stakeholders and the public; they supplement formal docket comment periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generic clearance for qualitative data on tobacco products and communications (PRA)
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA proposes a generic information-collection clearance for qualitative research to inform communications about tobacco risks, cessation, and FDA's regulatory role—used to develop and test messages and materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose is foundational research to understand audiences, improve messages and implementation strategies, and test messages affordably before full deployment; comments invited under the Paperwork Reduction Act.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory agenda inclusion and signaling of menthol/flavor/nicotine rulemakings
rubrics_metrics.description: Regulatory agendas list forthcoming actions such as 'Tobacco Product Standard for Menthol in Cigarettes', 'Tobacco Product Standard for Characterizing Flavors in Cigars', nicotine-level standards, and manufacturing practice requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inclusion in the regulatory agenda signals agency priorities, anticipated rulemaking activities, and provides summarized information for public review and planning for engagement (commenting, data submission, stakeholder preparation).
